question: What claim about transmission is at stake in attributing the teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters to an earth-mover?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
This is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is presented as transmitted by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The relation between the genitive class and the nominative bhūcarī is not syntactically explicit here.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
